tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open Day 2 — Alcaraz returns from wrist injury with 6-4, 6-4, 6-4 win over Safiullin; Sabalenka beats Osorio 6-2, 6-4 to begin third-title bid; Shelton rallies past Griekspoor; Tsitsipas upsets 10th seed Fils • [SQUASH] World Squash Masters Day 3 in Perth — seven-time champ Davenport and six-time champ Manley advance; 900+ players across 21 age groups at Karrinyup glass court • [BADMINTON] China Masters Super 750 opens in Shenzhen — Sindhu and Shetty withdraw for Asian Games prep; Christie beats Jun Hao in men's singles R1 • [PICKLEBALL] MLP proposes 2027 draft reset — $1M cap and $500K floor as 2024 picks enter draft pool; NJ 5s captured first title Sunday at Central Park • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Champions League Stage 1 done — Linz women go 3-0 in Budaörs; HB Ostrov perfect in Lille; Santa Tecla wins dramatic 3-2 qualifier

newsItems.title: Champions Begin US Open Defence
newsItems.excerpt: Carlos Alcaraz marked his return from a wrist injury with a straight-set win over Roman Safiullin, while Aryna Sabalenka cruised past Camila Osorio — Ben Shelton rallied past Tallon Griekspoor and Stefanos Tsitsipas upset 10th seed Arthur Fils.

newsItems.title: China Masters Opens With Withdrawals
newsItems.excerpt: PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty and several Indians pulled out of the Shenzhen Super 750 to focus on Asian Games prep — Jonatan Christie beat Leong Jun Hao 17-21, 19-21 in early men's singles action on Day 1.

newsItems.title: MLP Plans 2027 Roster Reset
newsItems.excerpt: Major League Pickleball is proposing a $1M salary cap, $500K spending floor and limited right of first refusal as all 2024 draft picks return to the pool — aiming for competitive balance after the New Jersey 5s' first title.

newsItems.title: ETTU Stage 1 Wraps, R16 Awaits
newsItems.excerpt: Linz AG Froschberg completed a perfect Group A run in Budaörs, while HB Ostrov went unbeaten in Lille and ASD TT Santa Tecla clinched a dramatic 3-2 win — eight Stage 1 clubs advance to the Round of 16.
